remarks: AVAILABLE ANNUAL UNFURNISHED. Tucked away on Saugatuck Island, this waterfront home is a beach lover's dream with only a 5-minute walk to several private beaches plus its own private dock overlooking the canal. Complete with three bedrooms, two full baths and an outdoor shower, this sun-drenched home has everything you need to experience the magic of beach living in Westport. Conveniently located to downtown, plus a 5-minute drive to the train station, with direct trains to Grand Central. Discover the blissful happiness of this home! Applicant must have good credit and apply through RentSpree.
